cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
from canonref import hdr
def vw(val,width): return (([1,2,4,8].index(width)<<(8*width-2))|val).to_bytes(width,'big')
# stream overlong in A with keys A
raw=b'\x0f'+vw(0,2)+vw(0,4)+vw(3,8)+b'abc'
can=b'\x0f'+v(0)+v(0)+v(3)+b'abc'
w=envelope('A',0,raw)
r=run(trace([{'keys':['A']},datagram(w,(0,))]))['traces'][0]
p=r['packets'][0]; exp=hdr('A',0,0,can); print('stream',p['status'],p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest())
# proper ack ecn
raw=b'\x03'+vw(5,4)+vw(1,2)+vw(0,2)+vw(5,2)+vw(1,2)+vw(2,2)+vw(3,4)
can=b'\x03'+v(5)+v(1)+v(0)+v(5)+v(1)+v(2)+v(3)
w=envelope('I',0,raw)
r=run(trace([datagram(w,(0,))]))['traces'][0]
p=r['packets'][0]; exp=hdr('I',0,0,can); print('ackecn',p['status'],p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest(),r['acknowledged'][0])
# close
raw=b'\x1c'+vw(0,2)+vw(0,2)+vw(2,2)+b'ok'+b'\x40'
can=b'\x1c'+v(0)+v(0)+v(2)+b'ok'
w=envelope('A',0,raw)
r=run(trace([{'keys':['A']},datagram(w,(0,))]))['traces'][0]
p=r['packets'][0];exp=hdr('A',0,0,can);print('close',p['status'],p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest(),r['closed'],r['datagrams'])
PY
